change: Replace the 2.6px inverse-depth blur factor with an authored 36mm vertical-sensor, f/1.8 thin-lens circle-of-confusion calculation and a fixed 65-sample gather. Existing continuous reciprocal-distance rack focus retained.
findings: The close flower remains in focus while the distant hall has depth separation.
Focus moves toward the architecture during the existing physical low-camera pullback.
At the end, near bud/leaves have softer focus while the main hall remains clear.
limitations: Camera optical parameters are authored choices; no reference EXIF was available.
The post gather has one screen-depth layer, so it cannot integrate hidden foreground colour or separate water's blended focus planes.
Static deterministic sampling removes time-varying random noise but does not by itself establish complete flicker-free motion or photographic quality.
Petal and architecture sculptural fidelity remain unaccepted.
sourceScope: Lens only; no material, geometry, exposure, lighting, camera path or pose change.
